title: Microsoft Purview: per-policy coverage report for auto-labeling
summary: The briefing passes: the report's navigation, prerequisites, coverage window and licensing statements are supported. It correctly distinguishes the roadmap's launched status from Learn's preview label and identifies the remaining report-specific documentation gaps.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview Information Protection gains a per-policy coverage report for auto-labeling policies.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The report compares files processed during policy enforcement with the latest simulation run.
claims.quote: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft says no action is required to receive this feature.
claims.quote: No action is required to receive this feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends updating internal operational documentation for administrators monitoring auto-labeling effectiveness.
claims.quote: Update internal operational documentation for administrators who monitor auto-labeling policy effectiveness.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The report arrives automatically for eligible policies without a separate administrator enablement action.
claims.quote: No action is required to receive this feature.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The report is a view within licensed service-side auto-labeling, so the licensing model is included.
claims.quote: Auto-labeling is gated by license, and the two surfaces (client-side and service-side) appear in different places in the portal.

claims.claim: Open coverage in Microsoft Purview portal through Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Coverage > View coverage.
claims.quote:
In the Microsoft Purview portal, go to **Information Protection** > **Policies** > **Auto-labeling policies**.
Select an auto-labeling policy that includes SharePoint or OneDrive, has completed simulation, and is turned on.
In the **Coverage** column, select **View coverage**.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or Graph interface for the coverage report is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'auto-labeling coverage Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy API', 'Purview coverage report Microsoft Graph API', and 'site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell AutoSensitivityLabel coverage'; read auto-labeling PowerShell guidance and Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy reference. No coverage interface found.

claims.claim: Open per-policy review pages in Microsoft Purview portal through Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > View details.
claims.quote: To open the newer review pages, go to **Solutions** > **Information Protection** > **Policies** > **Auto-labeling policies**. Select a policy, then select **View details** in the policy details panel.

claims.claim: Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -IncludeProgressFeedback retrieves per-policy labeling progress.
claims.quote:
The Identity parameter specifies the auto-labeling policy that you want to view. You can use any value that uniquely identifies the policy.
IncludeProgressFeedback specifies whether to include the labeling progress of files in SharePoint or OneDrive.

claims.claim: The cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The PowerShell call reports labeling progress for enabled auto-labeling policies.
claims.quote: If you use this switch, the command shows the progress of files to be labeled, files labeled in the last 7 days, and total files labeled for enabled auto-labeling policies.

claims.claim: The documented progress call does not provide the report's comparison with simulation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'auto-labeling coverage Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy API'; read the full Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy reference, including IncludeProgressFeedback and IncludeTestModeResults, and Learn coverage guidance. No simulation-to-enforcement coverage comparison documented for this call.
